name: copilot-atelier
description: Portable GitHub Copilot customization library: role-specific custom agents with handoffs and subagent allow-lists, and on-demand Agent Skills for PowerShell/DSC engineering (Sampler, Pester, Datum, AutomatedLab, WinRM, MECM), document conversion (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, Marp, pandoc), Outlook and Microsoft To Do automation, research and citation integrity, agentic-security review, and skill/prompt/agent evaluation. Instructions and hooks are not part of the plugin format and are deployed by Setup-CopilotSettings.ps1.
